params.body:
Ten scout sources stood under Not collecting at 17 to 20 failures each, half of them on HTTP 404 or "no usable content": addresses that never existed, a login wall, a page built in the browser. None of those recovers by being asked again, yet each was tried 25 times before parking.

## What changes
- `parkAfterFor(error, {after, dead})` in `packages/core/source-state.mjs` reads the last error: `HTTP 404`, `HTTP 410` and `no usable content` park after `dead`, everything else after `after`.
- `collect.mjs` uses it: `SOURCE_PARK_AFTER_DEAD` (default 3) next to `SOURCE_PARK_AFTER` (default 25). The log line names the error.
- A 403, 429, 5xx or `fetch failed` keeps the full 25: those can pass.

## After deploy
Sources already past 3 failures on a 404 or no usable content park at their next failed try (Lyst, Strava, Roblox, Common Sense Media, Canvas8, Twitch). Parked stays parked since #416.

## Tests
`test/source-parking.test.mjs`: 11 pass. Full suite 1564 of 1570; the 6 are report-render, which needs pdftoppm.
params.title: Park a source after 3 failures when its page is not there
